The audit output names Pygments and Requests, so please report those findings to the projects that maintain those dependencies. If you have evidence of a vulnerability in Rich itself, use the private reporting route in [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/SECURITY.md).
<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
